name: Unidentified droid (Boolan)
description: An old droid was repurposed by Baron Boolan of the Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era. The droid's processor was enslaved and imprisoned to the weapons targeting controls of a shuttle used by the Child of the Storm Sicarus, who could command the droid to fire upon nearby starships. Sicarus wondered whether the droid still had the ability to think; he assumed it would likely be insane, a thought that appealed to him.
